name: Perp-spot basis premium contrarian — short the over-rich perp (PERP, shorting required)
rationale: PERP / SHORT LEG (direction=-1) — requires perpetual short capability; NOT executable on Binance SPOT. The perp-spot basis (perp price minus spot, as a fraction) is the market's revealed price of leverage: a large POSITIVE basis means perp longs are paying a steep premium over spot to stay levered long — a crowded, over-leveraged-long regime that historically reverts as the marginal long is exhausted and the carry/funding bleed forces de-grossing. This is the basis cousin of the funding-contrarian crash filter, but basis is a SPOT-PERP price spread (a cleaner, higher-frequency crowding read) rather than the realized funding print, so it can fire EARLIER. The hypothesis: SHORT the perp when perp_spot_basis crosses UP through a fitted rich-premium ceiling (crowding extreme) AND price is NOT in a violent uptrend (a parabolic move is the short's adversary — the trend_ceiling guards against shorting into a melt-up). Funding accrues to the short as P&L each bar via funding_feature (a positive-basis regime is typically a positive-funding regime, so the short is PAID to wait). Exit when the basis normalizes back down through an exit floor (crowding relieved, thesis played out) or the stop/TP fires. Disconfirmer 1: the edge must be the basis EXTREME mean-reverting, not a generic short bias — if a plain unconditional short over the same sample/costs matches the deflated Sharpe, the basis ceiling adds nothing. Disconfirmer 2: basis and funding are tightly coupled; if dropping perp_spot_basis and entering on a funding_rate ceiling alone does as well, this is just the existing funding-contrarian spec re-skinned and adds no orthogonal basis information. Basis-gap stop is enforced at the risk layer when it lands. tier0 feature, unproven combination — low-confidence until validated OOS.
catalyst: perp_spot_basis crosses up into a rich-premium regime (perp longs over-paying for leverage) — a crowded long unwind setup.
